description: Search active public RoamWorthy caravan, motorhome and campervan model research pages by model, brand, vehicle type and berth range. Returns canonical model URLs and live-stock counts where available.

berthsMax.description: Model must support no more than this many minimum berths.

berthsMin.description: Model must support at least this many berths.

limit.description: Maximum results, default 8 and hard-capped at 10. Bulk export and pagination are intentionally unavailable.

liveStockOnly.description: When true, return only models with current live stock.

query.description: Model, range or brand search term. Single-character enumeration searches are rejected.

vehicleType.description: Restrict to caravan, motorhome or campervan.

name: search_models
title: Search RoamWorthy model research
